---
title: "repo-familiar"
subtitle: "Agentic engineering dotfiles for repeatable project setup"
---

`repo-familiar` collects reusable instructions, skills, templates, and documentation practices for AI-assisted software engineering.

The primary product is a project generator for downstream repositories. This repository is the canonical reference source; dotfiles are the metaphor for portable, personal defaults, not the boundary of the implementation.

## What This Site Tracks

- How to use the repository to start new projects.
- Architecture for templates, skills, and generated project assets.
- Design decisions and tradeoffs.
- Background research and reference links.
- User stories for the bootstrap workflow.

## Current Status

This is an initial documentation scaffold. The next milestone is to define the first project template and the interactive setup prompts that select agent harnesses, model providers, and documentation depth.
